2609.23529.title: Predicting Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Neural Operators via Observable Spectral Error Decomposition
2609.23529.paper_summary: Neural operators have emerged as powerful surrogates for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), yet their reliability under distribution shift remains a critical barrier to deployment. Existing approaches to out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization in operator learning are largely empirical and black-box: they report aggregate error metrics without explaining why errors arise or when they will grow. We propose a structure-preserving framework that makes OOD generalization predictable and auditable. Our key idea is to parameterize the learned solution operator as a spectral filter $h_θ(λ)$ acting on the eigenvalues of the underlying elliptic operator, implemented via Chebyshev polynomial expansions and trained with a weak-form objective. This parameterization admits an exact decomposition of the energy-norm error into two observable components: a model-dependent spectral approximation term and a distribution-dependent spectral weighting term induced by the input. From this decomposition we derive three diagnostics: a conservative in-band supremum $\vareps_{\mathrm{sup}}$, a global RMS proxy $\vareps_{\mathrm{rms}}$, and a sample-dependent effective metric $\vareps_{\mathrm{eff}}(f)$. These diagnostics can be computed without access to ground-truth solutions. Through four controlled experiments, we show that $\vareps_{\mathrm{eff}}(f)\|f\|$ consistently predicts energy error under in-distribution, in-band spectral shift, out-of-band tail, and compound shifts, whereas global metrics can be systematically misleading. Our framework shifts OOD assessment of neural operators from black-box benchmarking to operator-structure diagnostics, providing a practical route to auditable scientific machine learning.
2609.23529.paper_summary_zh: 神經運算子已成為解決偏微分方程（PDEs）的強大替代方案，但其在分佈轉移下的可靠性仍然是部署的一個關鍵障礙。現有的運算子學習中對於分佈外（OOD）泛化的研究主要是經驗性的，且為黑箱模型：它們報告總體錯誤指標，但未解釋錯誤產生的原因或何時會增長。我們提出了一個保持結構的框架，使得OOD泛化變得可預測且可審計。我們的關鍵思想是將學習到的解運算子參數化為作用於基礎橢圓運算子的特徵值的頻譜濾波器 $h_θ(λ)$，通過切比雪夫多項式展開實現，並使用弱形式目標進行訓練。這種參數化允許將能量範數誤差精確分解為兩個可觀察的組件：一個依賴於模型的頻譜近似項和一個由輸入引起的依賴於分佈的頻譜加權項。從這個分解中，我們推導出三個診斷指標：保守的帶內上界 $\vareps_{\mathrm{sup}}$、全局均方根代理 $\vareps_{\mathrm{rms}}$，以及依賴於樣本的有效度量 $\vareps_{\mathrm{eff}}(f)$。這些診斷指標可以在不接觸真實解的情況下計算。通過四個控制實驗，我們顯示 $\vareps_{\mathrm{eff}}(f)\|f\|$ 在帶內、帶內頻譜轉移、帶外尾部和復合轉移下持續預測能量誤差，而全局指標則可能系統性地誤導。我們的框架將神經運算子的OOD評估從黑箱基準轉變為運算子結構診斷，提供了一條可審計的科學機器學習的實用途徑。
